# telnyx_telephony_credentials (Data Source)

Lists telephony credentials, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_telephony_credential`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_name` (String) Filter by name
- `filter_resource_id` (String) Filter by resource_id
- `filter_sip_username` (String) Filter by sip_username
- `filter_status` (String) Filter by status
- `filter_tag` (String) Filter by tag
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `telephony_credentials` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--telephony_credentials))

<a id="nestedatt--telephony_credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `telephony_credentials`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) ISO-8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `expired` (Boolean) Defaults to false
- `expires_at` (String) ISO-8601 formatted date indicating when the resource will expire.
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `name` (String)
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `resource_id` (String) Identifies the resource this credential is associated with.
- `sip_password` (String, Sensitive) The randomly generated SIP password for the credential.
- `sip_username` (String) The randomly generated SIP username for the credential.
- `token_material` (Attributes, Sensitive) What a server needs to mint login tokens for the credential itself, with no request per token (`TelephonyCredential#to_jwt` in telnyx-ruby 3.1.0 or later). As sensitive as `sip_password`: keep it on the server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--telephony_credentials--token_material))
- `updated_at` (String) ISO-8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was updated.
- `user_id` (String) Identifies the user this credential is associated with.

<a id="nestedatt--telephony_credentials--token_material"></a>
### Nested Schema for `telephony_credentials.token_material`

Read-Only:

- `kid` (String) Identifies the Telnyx signing key the `signing_secret` was derived with. Goes in the token header.
- `signing_secret` (String) The HMAC-SHA256 key the token is signed with, base64url without padding.
- `tel_token` (String) Opaque value Telnyx uses to resolve the credential. Carried in the token's `tel_token` claim as is.
